resources.string: Choose how chat shares fullscreen video. Off keeps the original chat beside the game; on places transparent chat over the full-size game. Example: enable here or in the player menu for overlay chat, choose its side in Chat settings, and type in the box at the bottom. Use the usual chat button to hide or show it. Portrait, mini-player and PiP keep their normal layout.
Places fullscreen chat on the left or right, for both docked and transparent layouts. Example: choose the left if chat covers a scoreboard on the right. Reopen the player after changing this setting.

Darkens the background behind chat without fading text or emotes. Example: 0 leaves only text over the game; 70 adds a dark backdrop for busy video. Defaults to 0. An existing choice from an earlier build is retained; choose 0 for full transparency. Applies when chat is next shown.
Adds bold text and a dark shadow over video. Example: keep messages readable over bright gameplay. Sidebar styling is restored when chat docks.
